purpose: fixed 2D teacher to persistent world road Gaussian distillation

parameter_framework.theta: existing frozen reusable completion prior; no new shared network training
parameter_framework.eta_st: fixed original camera color convention; no free exposure or white-balance estimates
parameter_framework.scene_asset: direct per-Gaussian native-sRGB road RGB, constrained effective opacity and tangent scales; prior atlas immutable, not claimed as the learned shader field

future_model_protocol.canonical_appearance: reference-camera appearance; do not claim identifiable intrinsic reflectance
future_model_protocol.observations: immutable measured RGB/source/confidence ledger, distinct from optimized Gaussian shader RGB
future_model_protocol.shared_theta: pretrain only on declared BUILD street segments; freeze during scene adaptation and evaluation
future_model_protocol.scene_z: low-dimensional bounded corrections; no free independently optimized missing-pixel RGB as a claim of learned cross-street regularity
future_model_protocol.imaging_gauge: anchor reference frame exposure/white balance to identity; remove duplicated global gain/color degrees from z, and constrain residual eta mean to zero
future_model_protocol.marking: separate asphalt and paint; optimize only observable curve, width, period or phase parameters; keep unobservable phase unknown

frames.inherited_BUILD: existing 199-frame observations and LiDAR used in baseline construction; no held-out claim

supervision.A: real unobstructed road RGB, excluding foreground/retained objects and C holes
supervision.B: not run as a formal blind test; any later blind test must exclude held-out world regions before all assets/caches/retrieval
supervision.C: frozen raw86/raw110 2D completion in physical_unknown intersect independent write permission and valid road support; shadow/effect and observed guard belt separate and not trained as holes; pseudo truth, not real hidden-road ground truth
supervision.source_version: same frozen teacher for old-stage2 and direct3D comparison; no new SD generation or selection

rendering.operator: actual existing native Gaussian raster and original calibrated cameras
rendering.color: original sRGB appearance convention, not intrinsic reflectance or recovered physical radiance
rendering.low_alpha: no unstable RGB/alpha loss; fixed sufficient-alpha color support, full holes remain in coverage evaluation
rendering.masking: fixed A and C masks; independent normalized losses and counts; no live shrinking of evaluation denominator

optimizer_draft.name: Adam
optimizer_draft.parameter_constraints: RGB [0,1]; effective loader opacity in [initial_effective,1-1e-5]; tangent scales no larger than original R8 absolute 1.15 envelope and supported-world footprint; normal scale fixed

marking.long_term: asphalt base plus paint layer generated from verifiable curves/width/dash period/phase
marking.first_probe: no new structure network; real verified segments may receive edge supervision, generated edges only low-confidence pseudo supervision
marking.unknown: dash phase remains unknown; no forced structure ground truth

acceptance.teacher: C error falls by at least 20% separately on raw86 and raw110 versus unchanged old-stage2 baseline
acceptance.visible: A real-road error increases no more than 0.002 absolute sRGB L1 per frame; visual inspection also required
acceptance.diagnostics: raw134/179/198 no obvious new blocks, marking drift or gaps; numerical metrics cannot replace image inspection
acceptance.coverage: at least 37404/38416 pixels alpha>0.9 and no per-frame regression versus baseline
acceptance.retained: all 77266 baseline retained pixel-frames unchanged in joint rendering, exact float comparison reported
acceptance.persistence: public saved loader matches live RGB/alpha within 1e-6; RGB8 differences reported separately
acceptance.verdict: mechanical and visual outcomes separate; human_verdict remains null

control.baseline: fixed old-stage2 reevaluated at same cameras, teacher, masks and pixel counts
control.matched_F_control: same phase2 initialization, parameters, A labels, masks, optimizer, seed and 200/300/300 budget; only C target replaced by immutable old atlas projection
control.attribution: matched control isolates C target source, not an exact replay of all old-stage2 implementation choices
control.intermediate_assets: report each stage in both runs

checkpoint: each stage saves parameters, optimizer, sampler and RNG; test full restoration, next update and next-stage entry in real GPU smoke
accounting: 800 direct-teacher formal updates plus 800 matched-F-control formal updates; all smoke and engineering replays listed separately; failed runs preserved
scope: module2 five-frame probe only; no static handoff training, no new199 run, no pretrained network finetuning
hyperparameters_status: locked; actual source and supervision bindings recorded in each frozen_contract.json

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.stage_transition: one grouped optimizer; preserve moments; frozen groups grad=None and lr=0

trainer_contract.color_parameter: direct per-active-road-Gaussian native-sRGB c_i; projected to [0,1] after update; no theta/delta bound

color_scope.A_seen: active geometrically legal road rows with actual road-only alphaT contribution to fixed A photo domain
color_scope.C_only: same actual C contribution, excluding known measured prior rows unless also A_seen
color_scope.always_frozen: full retained-world guard, legacy-near guard, unsupported road geometry and rows not contributing to either training domain

trainer_contract.opacity_scope: actual A/C coverage contribution rows within physical legal supported road, excluding retained/legacy-near guards
trainer_contract.opacity_constraint: effective native loader initial probability hard lower; upper 1-1e-5; frozen raw values preserved
trainer_contract.tangent_scale_constraint: current S2 sigma lower bound; absolute upper bound from original R8 sigma*1.15 and actual world-supported boundary; no compounding; normal sigma frozen
trainer_contract.fixed_photo_gate: A or common-valid C mask intersect initial actual road alpha>0.9; frozen before all updates
trainer_contract.C_pairing: photo_C common F0-valid fixed mask; coverage_C full geometry-qualified Cteacher independent of F0 color; both arms share identical masks and q
trainer_contract.premultiplied_photo: actual black-background native raster P_sRGB versus stopgrad(alpha_photo)*teacher_sRGB; never RGB/alpha
trainer_contract.joint_gradient_routing: photo raster explicitly detaches current opacity and scales; coverage raster explicitly detaches current RGB

normalization.photo: A and C each divide by their own fixed q-weight sum times 3 channels; q is binary validity unless calibrated values exist
normalization.edge: horizontal and vertical first differences; both pixels must be in the same fixed A or common-C gate; each domain divides by its own valid pair-weight sum times 3
normalization.alpha: A/C legal geometry coverage masks independent of initial alpha gate; MSE to 1, each domain normalized independently
normalization.keep: outside and retained masks each independently normalized; baseline road-only premult RGB/alpha are preservation references, never road truth
normalization.RGB_prior: mean squared change from c_i initialization across eligible color rows and channels

stage_losses.color: L_A + 0.5 L_C + 0.1 edge_A + 0.01 edge_C + outside_RGB + 4 retained_RGB + 0.001 prior
stage_losses.joint: sum of color and coverage objectives with the explicitly separated gradient routes

trainer_contract.baseline_comparison: same initialized old S2 road asset re-evaluated on identical true-A and pseudo-C masks
trainer_contract.source_binding: protocol and trainer source; immutable A/C/F supervision freeze; current source scene/proof/road; original R8 absolute scale envelope; complete row scopes
required_phase0: photo gradients to opacity/scales exactly zero
coverage gradients to RGB exactly zero
stage boundary entry and independent public saved loader

matched_control: same initialized S2 and scopes; only selected_C_srgb target differs
final_coverage_C: full legal Cteacher geometry including F0-invalid color; common photo C masks unchanged
retained_guard: actual installed native CUDA maximum-sigma radii, 16x16 tile-expanded bounds plus rounding margin, five-frame full K union; 38982 active rows guarded
numerical_replay: full saved state restores exactly; next update nonbitwise opacity logits max7.45e-9 and Adam max3.55e-15, below preregistered1e-6; no bitwise claim
